game_concept: A strategy race set in Eldritch Ruins – Spirit Hall, a hall of wandering spirits: the scholar mage must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Mutation Mystery: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Spirit Hall: a hall of wandering spirits
core_gameplay_loop: In Spirit Hall, repeat each round: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the scholar mage ahead. Then check the mutation_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ancient lock by solving code steps involving mutation_safe that move the scholar mage forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.2).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ancient lock first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Mutation Mystery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mutation Mystery' (Week 7 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Spirit Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how mutation_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crypt crawlers in Spirit Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.2).
